description:
This defines what sound will play based on above or below relative position to a note block.
An instrument can be assigned to the "up" and "down" faces where at least one face needs to be defined for the component to be valid.
If either face is undefined, or the component is omitted, it will use its default values: "up" = "note.harp" and "down" = "note.none".
"note.none" can be used to specify no sound for a face.
title: Instrument Sound
